name: Fix warehouse reservations and build orders on top (multi-file)
instruction: Two files. FIX warehouse.js: createWarehouse() manages stock per sku with add(sku, qty), available(sku), reserve(sku, qty) -> reservationId (string) or null when insufficient AVAILABLE stock (available = on-hand minus active reservations — the current code oversells because it checks on-hand only), release(reservationId) (returns reserved stock to available; idempotent — releasing twice must not double-credit), and confirm(reservationId) (consumes the reservation: on-hand decreases, reservation closes; confirming an unknown or already-closed reservation returns false). THEN IMPLEMENT orders.js: createOrders(warehouse) with placeOrder(lines) where lines is [{sku, qty}, ...]: atomically reserve EVERY line (if any line cannot be reserved, release the lines already reserved and return {ok:false, reason:'insufficient', sku:<first failing sku>}), otherwise return {ok:true, orderId}; fulfill(orderId) confirms all reservations of that order and returns true (false for unknown/already-fulfilled); cancel(orderId) releases all of the order's reservations and returns true (false for unknown/already-fulfilled/cancelled). No dependencies, CommonJS.
verifyCmd: node -e "const {createWarehouse}=require('./warehouse.js');const {createOrders}=require('./orders.js');let w=createWarehouse();w.add('x',10);const r1=w.reserve('x',4);if(w.available('x')!==6){console.error('avail after reserve');process.exit(1)}w.release(r1);w.release(r1);if(w.available('x')!==10){console.error('idempotent release, got',w.available('x'));process.exit(1)}const r2=w.reserve('x',10);if(!r2||w.reserve('x',1)){console.error('exact reserve/oversell');process.exit(1)}if(!w.confirm(r2)){console.error('confirm');process.exit(1)}if(w.confirm(r2)){console.error('double confirm');process.exit(1)}if(w.available('x')!==0){console.error('onhand after confirm');process.exit(1)}w=createWarehouse();w.add('a',5);w.add('b',2);const o=createOrders(w);const bad=o.placeOrder([{sku:'a',qty:3},{sku:'b',qty:5}]);if(bad.ok!==false||bad.sku!=='b'){console.error('atomic fail line');process.exit(1)}if(w.available('a')!==5){console.error('rollback released a, got',w.available('a'));process.exit(1)}const good=o.placeOrder([{sku:'a',qty:3},{sku:'b',qty:2}]);if(!good.ok){console.error('good order');process.exit(1)}if(w.available('a')!==2||w.available('b')!==0){console.error('post-order avail');process.exit(1)}const o2=o.placeOrder([{sku:'a',qty:2}]);if(!o2.ok){console.error('second order');process.exit(1)}if(!o.cancel(o2.orderId)){console.error('cancel');process.exit(1)}if(o.cancel(o2.orderId)){console.error('double cancel');process.exit(1)}if(w.available('a')!==2){console.error('avail after cancel');process.exit(1)}if(!o.fulfill(good.orderId)){console.error('fulfill');process.exit(1)}if(o.fulfill(good.orderId)){console.error('double fulfill');process.exit(1)}if(w.available('a')!==2||w.available('b')!==0){console.error('final avail');process.exit(1)}console.log('ok')"
